title: Malmgren tweet on Bluegill tests and JFK Los Alamos visit
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren tweet on Bluegill tests and JFK Los Alamos visit, about 1961-1962 at Los Alamos, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: tweeted am now reconstructing my personal interactions with Los Alamos Lawrence G bluegill ICBM interception tests 1961 62 and JFK visit to Los alos November 1962

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads out a post on social media by Harold Malmgren, a former government adviser. In it, Michels says, Malmgren wrote that he was piecing together his own dealings with Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons lab, during the 1961 and 1962 Bluegill tests, which he called tests of intercepting long-range nuclear missiles, and President John F. Kennedy's visit there in November 1962. Michels raises it in a talk about UFOs being seen around nuclear sites.
